intro: Enter Prompt in Gemini For 1st Listing Appointment Prep:
prompt:
[INSERT ADDRESS] - Do deep research and be highly accurate and exact with ALL information. Give me a short, highly scannable cheat sheet for a listing appointment. The seller might see my screen, so DO NOT include any advice to me, tables, conversational filler, or labels like "Talking Point". I only want raw data and professional market impact. First thing is to put the address & municipality. Make all the info bullet pointed separately so it’s all easy to read.

• Property Specs: Year built, acreage (omit if townhouse/condo), sq ft, beds/baths, any utility info, and a quick note on how the size/lot compares to neighbors.

• Carrying Costs: Latest annual taxes, estimated HOA (if applicable), and 1 sentence on how this impacts buyer affordability.

• Ownership History: Last purchase date and price, plus 1 sentence on their equity position and how the home's condition (updated vs. original) dictates the price.

• Comps: Include all actively listed, currently under contract, and recently sold on the same street or within the same neighborhood within the past 2 years (be very accurate) & 1 highly relevant recent comp, the top market value ceiling, and the as-is price floor. Make sure to put how many days on market each comp was on for before going under contract/pending.

Also give the zestimate and any other home evaluation from major websites.

Make it extremely quick to read at a glance.
